skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: The ultimate stealth role. Has access to every room in the Mega-Corp, but nobody looks twice at a janitor.

skills.name: Brawl
skills.description: Fighting unarmed or with improvised weapons (like a floor buffer).

talents_and_abilities.name: Symbiotic Telekinetic Tendrils
talents_and_abilities.description: 6 invisible telekinetic tendrils attached to their psyche/aura. Each tendril MUST be doing something/touching something, or Luckii starts losing sanity. They act independently unless Luckii is asleep or tranquilized. The tendrils have names and moods that mutually influence Luckii's brain moods.

narrative_profile.physical_description: Janitor uniform, surrounded by 6 invisible tendrils.
narrative_profile.backstory: A janitor at the Mega-Corp who bonded with a telekinetic symbiote.

strength.name: Unseen
strength.description: Nobody looks twice at the janitor, giving Luckii unparalleled access.

flaw.name: Symbiotic Dependency
flaw.description: The tendrils must be appeased or Luckii loses their mind.

desire.name: Stimulation
desire.description: The psyche is euphoric and highly stimulated by chaos.

fear.name: Containment
fear.description: Being tranquilized or locked away where the tendrils can't reach anything.
